docstring:
/******************************************************************************  
Summary:  
Skips the mipmap images for uncompressed RGB or RGBA DDS files if they are textures or cube maps.

Parameters:  
image (Image*): Pointer to the image being processed.  
dds_info (DDSInfo*): Pointer to the DDS information structure.  
pixel_size (int): Size of each pixel in bytes.  
exception (ExceptionInfo*): Pointer to the exception information structure.

Returns:  
MagickBooleanType: Returns MagickFalse if an error occurs, otherwise returns MagickTrue.

Logic:  
The function checks if the DDS file has mipmaps and is either a texture or a cube map. If so, it attempts to skip the mipmap images by seeking through the image data based on the width, height, and pixel size. It handles potential end-of-file errors and adjusts the dimensions for each mipmap level.  
******************************************************************************/
guard_description: Check for unexpected end-of-file (EOF) before processing mipmap data
rationale: Implementation B includes a check for an unexpected end-of-file (EOF) before attempting to skip mipmap data, which is absent in implementation A. This check helps prevent errors when reading past the end of the file.
